What changed, why, and which previous conclusions are affected:

## Evidence and coverage

Link the investigation package (`research/assets/<asset>.md`), public evidence, capture manifests, explicit block cutoffs and unresolved gaps. Distinguish observations, attributed statements and hypotheses. Explain any changed matching thresholds with transaction-level examples.

## Verification

- [ ] `./verify.ps1` passes; list the tested commit and any platform limitations.
- [ ] Public reports were regenerated, not hand-edited; changed classifications and totals are explained.
- [ ] Missing data remains unknown; matches and exchange labels are not presented as proof of settlement or ownership.
- [ ] Candidate addresses have chain-specific role evidence. Internal movements and representation conversions are not double-counted.
- [ ] New or modified files and staged diff were reviewed for credentials and private/community identifying information, including capture URLs and document metadata.
- [ ] No raw chat export, private community submission, local connection details or private keys are included.
- [ ] If claiming completion, the common-cutoff claims/vault ledger and all adjustments satisfy CONTRIBUTING.md; passing CI alone is not completion.

## Site publication

State whether this PR updates the public site or only adds research. If it updates the site, describe the preview checks and link its assessment. Do not copy BUSD-specific fees or presentation into another asset.
